manifestDescription.message: Adds the current page URL or hostname to the window title so desktop tools such as password managers and activity trackers can identify the active page.

optionsShowFullUrlHelp.message: Choose whether the title contains only the hostname, the complete URL, or the URL without query parameters and fragments.

optionsUrlModeFullNoQuery.message: Full URL without query or fragment

optionsSeparatorStringHelp.message: Text placed between the original page title and the URL, for example '-' or '::'.

optionsShowFieldAttributesText.message: Show field attributes when a text input has focus?

optionsShowFieldAttributesHelp.message: When enabled, the name and id attributes of supported text input fields are appended to the title while the field has focus. This can help password-manager auto-type rules distinguish fields on the same page.

optionsSavedMessage.message: Changes are applied to open tabs automatically.

diagnosticsCheckingDetail.message: Testing whether the extension content script can reach this tab.

diagnosticsPrivacy.message: Diagnostics stay inside the browser and are not stored or transmitted.

diagnosticsReachableDetail.message: The content script is running and the current title matches the extension output.

diagnosticsOverriddenDetail.message: The content script is running, but the title did not match the expected extension output at the instant of this check.

diagnosticsWebUnreachableDetail.message: This is a normal web page, but the extension did not answer. Site permissions, browser policy, or an unsupported browser path may be blocking injection.

diagnosticsInheritedDetail.message: about:blank, about:srcdoc, data:, and blob: documents can only be modified when the browser assigns a supported opener or origin.

diagnosticsRestrictedDetail.message: Browser-internal and privileged pages reject WebExtension content scripts by design. The extension cannot modify this title.

diagnosticsFileDetail.message: This extension is intentionally limited to HTTP and HTTPS pages and does not request file access.

diagnosticsExtensionPageDetail.message: The extension does not modify its own internal pages.

diagnosticsUnknownDetail.message: The browser did not expose a supported page that this extension can diagnose. Third-party Android System WebViews do not load browser extensions.
